redCandidate.setup: Create a temporary root, capture matching baseline and F1 receipts, initialize a two-feature delivery ledger, then submit F1's public acceptance evidence.
redCandidate.expected: The public Rex transition API accepts F1's matching receipt and returns continue for F2.
redCandidate.observed: The initializer test passed, while the transition test observed rex.advanceLongRunningDelivery as undefined.
redCandidate.failureReason: Rex has no public long-running evidence transition API, so it cannot advance the feature ledger from accepted F1 to F2.
